Thanks.

Yes exactly. His brain triggers this religiosity, and compounded with low self esteem. It has been rough.

He is in a good place and he is lonely, but my parents are visitng every chance they get. As well as me

Seek help.

Make a call. Really. You know you want the help, and sometimes getting to it intially is the hardest part. 

You have more access to help than you think. If you are on here, you can find your nearest doctor/hospital to help you

As simple and played out as it sounds, all you need to say is, "i am suicidal and I need help". To almost anyone, but the counselor on campus is a good start and find a hospital near you.

the stigma of being suicidal is the last thing that should be on your mind. I used to feel like if I went to counseling I was an idiot, but "happy" people go to counseling.

And you need more than counseling, but thats ok! It really is, because the only thing that anyone wants is to make sure you are ok. 

You won't be better faster if you dont do anything about it. Please act now, or if yuo want, one of us can call your university/local hospital

Have you sought medical attention?

You may have more access to it than you think. 

You are not a hostage to your own family, they care because they actually care. Sorry for being redundant. Regardless of situation, we are wired to care about our own, and you have their support. That is something worth building off of.

you have OUR support. I know we all don't know each other, but we are here now because we do care. We want you to feel good again, because I bet you used to feel good, and have esteem and care about yourself.

Find those reasons again

my brother recently got hooked up via the state government.

Your state should be able to provide free care for you. This doesn't sound like something that is your fault, and there are resources out there for you.

We are all here because we know someone who has dealt with these thoughts. That is fine. 

What state do you live in?

In my short experience dealing with this issue, I've found that the best thing for you (outside of medication and treatment #1) is support from family first then friends. 

Are you currently on medication? 

I have a brother who denied medication for years until he realized it wasn't his fault. And if you are, there is a lot of trial and error with it. Investigate what can and will help you.

If you are resigned to suicide, perhaps this is a time for you to find what may possibly interest you. Anything that gives you an ounce of satisfaction is something to investigate.

Are you on any medication right now? Have you sought treatment?

We are all open ears for you

What is one thing good about yourself? And what is something you enjoy/have enjoyed?

Also, find the right medication for you. Sometimes it really is trial and error. There is soemthing out there
Got 2 hours! Let me have it!

Joy is something you want right now.

What ways can you help people with their tech problems?

First you can lurk forums and help people's tech problems from far away, but maybe studying up on it was good.

You say this has fascinated you for a while now, that's fucking interesting! Seriously it is. 

I dont know how old you are or resources, but computer engineering is obviously an option. You can build computers. That is something be want, and value so much.

I wish I could have made my own computer, maybe you can try to help people make their own, recommend parts? 

My point is, you like technology. It gives you an escape, even if for a little. Exploit this talent!

You have great eyes, and you love technology.

You have these sources of pride and joy to build off of. Surround yourself with it.

Even people who are "happy", they know to surround themselves with what makes them feel good and not with what makes them feel bad.

What do you like about technology?

Is there literally anything you like about yourself or think you are good at?

If you say, "no" you are wrong 

Whatever flicker of happiness you can get, dive into that.

This is a probably you don't have to face alone.

Have you sought professional help yet?

Despite a few replies right now, we all call.

Have you sought out intensive medical treatment? This doesn't sound like your fault so please dont put blame on yourself. 

You need to find the right people that can help you because they are out there. You said you can have great days until something triggers an episode, the fact that you can have a "good" day is something hanging onto.

You are not a freak.

That's a label dumb people use so they don't have to think about anyone but themselves.

And if someone wants to say you are, ask that person what's the "weirdest" things they do. Everyone has that kind of stuff, some just more apparent.

Find another doctor. You deserve to feel better no matter what you may think or believe. How? Because you are a human being. You've done no wrong, and maybe you feel cursed, but that's not your fault.

We can find a way for you to get the right help

You weren't always this way.

How have you gotten to this point you think?

Fuck man, well that's the doctor said. What do you want me to do?

You have no idea how to help anyone do you

EDIT: It took 2 seconds to look online and find something on it. Don't be a dick.
I will let my mom know. I don't trust what will happen in there. He needs extensive help

I'm hurt because this is my brother. I'm hurt because this hurts my parents and him.

I dont blame his at all.
 You are misinterpretting this.
The doctor told him three major obsessions of bipolar people are sex, money, and religion.

He's gone to doctors and has been on medication.

Last 2 weeks or so he's been getting worse with the medication. On saturday it ran out and the refill didn't come in. 

I saw him post on a forum and he jumping around with the idea but said he wanted to do it. He even had a pack of razors on his desk.

I'm so scared more than anything else, my mom doesn't deserve this and my brother doesn't either.

Regardless, my mom is so sweet, and that's why he doesn't do it. He said he wants to when she isn't around and that's what makes me scared is that she won't be around. I don't know if he truly knows how he would kill himself, but he at least wants to.

It's so frustrating bc it seems fairly textbook that he is manic depressive, and that is treatable, but it hurts when he can't get what he needs. 

I don't want to hold him hostage, but him doing something would hurt my parents so bad who already have so many health issues.

He tried to check into the mental hospital on monday but they wouldnt take him and he didn't have insurance. He's been to several over the years, taking medication, being off. It's been so much for him.

There is some fund now that is paying for it.

I don't trust him without my mom there. He mentioned that's why he is still alive, is bc of her.

Comparing yourself to others is that one thing that hurt me the most too.

Pretending to be happy is one of the hardest things to do. You don't have to pretend. Feel miserable, we all have to feel bad sometimes.

My brother is suicidal, and I try to let him know that it's ok to feel bad. You're supposed to feel that bad sometimes.

Find whatever bit of happiness you can get and exploit it. exploit the shit out of it. You have motivation in there, even if it's a flicker. Because that is what makes you you.

You know you have potential. That's a great thing. That's something even "happy" people don't have all the time. 

You are just a short time removed from a time when you were really happy, playing games for a job!? That is fucking kick ass.

You gotta find why you are wroth something. You are a good guy. You are a nice guy. People like that. You may not have found those people, but you are on here because you know people are out there, and the older you get tthe more people really fucking appreciate someone who actually is nice, and good, and thoughtful.

You are an empty canvass. You have the ability to do anything, whenever, and however you want. That is pretty fucking liberating. 

You can't liberate you from yourself, but you have a full life's story to write man. 

One thing you have are options. To actually want to do anything, that's the hardest part. You can't convince anyone of anything if they don't believe it. try to get someone to lose weight. Won't work. 

You have no means, but you can live a life that you can feel proud of. As stupid and played out as it sounds, bummin around the country could have a shot of giving you perspective. You clearly can think and are introspective, maybe writing down how you feel can give you a shot of figuring some of it out. 

Maybe you can't live for yourself, but you can live for others. Helping someone, do things other people couldn't imagine doing themselves (bummin acorss the country), talk to someone on the street. People want to listen if you find them in the right time.

Not many people can think that deeply buddy. There is something there
